title: Senior Manager - R And D (Project Management)
description:
Lead end-to-end R&D and NPD projects from concept to production. Develop and manage project plans, timelines, milestones, budgets and resources. Drive tractor platform development, product improvement and engineering projects. Coordinate with Design, Testing, Homologation, Quality, Manufacturing, SCM and Service teams. Track project progress, risks, delays and critical issues, ensuring timely resolution. Conduct project reviews and ensure milestone and action-plan closure. Manage prototype, engineering changes, testing and validation activities. Ensure project delivery within cost, quality, performance and timeline targets. Support VA/VE, cost reduction and product upgrades. Prepare project dashboards, MIS and management reports for senior leadership. Improve PMO processes, project tracking systems and governance mechanisms. Lead project teams and ensure effective cross-functional collaboration.

Key Skills: Project Estimation,Project Management,Project Tracking,Project planning & Execution,Project Scheduling,PMO,Project Coordination,Scheduling

title: Customer Support Executive
description:
CSE profile starts with handling client query related to generalize accounting software. Require to provide telephonic or online support for software installation, training on the software and other routine queries including accounting queries. Provide client support while trouble shooting like printer setup query etc. Handle complaints or objections if any and report or escalate the same to the next level for further solution. Handle frequent reviews and follow-ups with clients as per need. Collaborate with team members to achieve better results.

Key Skills: Customer Support,Software Support,Client Coordination,Customer Support Executive,Support Executive,Client Support Executive.,ERP Support,Client Satisfaction
